scope: Randomized variants of the Warlock reference requests against 2 and 5 targets with Rain of Fire and Hellfire lines, of the Destruction build with Bane of Havoc against 3 and 5, and of the Affliction and Destruction builds with multidot lines for their dots against 3 and 4 (validation/2026-10-06-warlock-multi-target-sweep/*.base.json), 40 for each base at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical, and draws each variant's race.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-warlock-multi-target-sweep/SPEC.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 40 --iterations 200 --races RaceHuman,RaceGnome,RaceOrc,RaceUndead --output <scratch>/SPEC for each base; each variant <scratch>/SPEC/sweep-XX.json is compared as SPEC-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every request matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
